/ / Simulated form submission text data
const formSubmission = {
Email_ID: "ziq@gmail.com",
Name: "ziqa",
Age: 26,
feedback: "positive",
submittedAt: "2026-06-06T09:44:52.420-04:00"
};

// 1. Logic to determine discount
function processWorkflow(formData) {
let give_discount = "no";

// BUG 1: Using a single '=' assigns the value instead of comparing it.
// It will always evaluate to true. Change to '==='
if (formData.feedback = "positive") {
give_discount = "yes";
}

formData.give_discount = give_discount;
return formData;
}

// 2. Simulate saving to Google Sheets
function appendToGoogleSheets(data) {
console.log(`[Google Sheets] Successfully appended row for:
${data.Name}`);
return true;
}

// 3. Send text notification to Discord
async function sendDiscordNotification(data) {
const webhookUrl = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/mock_id";

const messageText = `
🚨 New Form Submission Received! 🚨
Name: ${data.Name}
Feedback: ${data.feedback}
Discount Given: ${data.give_discount}
`;

// BUG 2: Discord webhooks expect a JSON object with a "content" key.
// Sending a raw string directly will cause an API error.
// It should be: body: JSON.stringify({ content: messageText })
const response = await fetch(webhookUrl, {
method: "POST",
headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
body: messageText
});

if (response.ok) {
console.log("Discord notification sent successfully!");
} else {
console.log("Failed to send Discord notification.");
}
}

// --- Execution ---
// BUG 3: Typo in the variable name. 'formSubmisison' has 'is' swapped.
// It will throw a ReferenceError: formSubmisison is not defined.
const processedData = processWorkflow(formSubmisison);
appendToGoogleSheets(processedData);
sendDiscordNotification(processedData);
